folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B290: livelihood result scope and parent queue
folds.body:
The full [three-row coverage](COVERAGE.json), release and root joins were read together with the full [parent queue](../../QUEUE.json). ALL3 means the named livelihood source rows, not all audited gaps or completed player journeys. The parent queue's 22 source-delivered candidates mean its historical first three plus remainder19, not 22 native-verified features. Empty remainingLatestCandidates does not erase the explicit implemented-unverified status, connected behaviorVerified=false entries or later five-group behavioral/save/native backlog. Old current-build labels and the October18 routing qualification retain their dates.

The useful three-row contract remains concrete. Two finite Orr shifts reserve real supplied stock/coins and his own operation/body/attention/stamina/site; produced kits belong to the worker before any separately paid or permitted current-stock collection. Lio uses his actual current membership, kit, body, control and stamina, while the existing party/battle consumer sees actual occupation. A shared Orr/Vale toolkit choice reserves one actual claim and tool with separate owned means; Vale additionally needs sap and a still-wet supported bench. A historical completion receipt cannot recreate loose stock or pay for an obsolete wet-bench purpose.

Funding custody differs from wages and supplies already spent. The two held coins are actual transferred means, not a mirror of native money; Orr/Vale's successful wage and fittings expenditure and Lio's full wage remain separate local rules. Cancellation plus pre-result sponsorship withdrawal is one publication plan, returning exact reservations to the proper owner. Successful toolkit gifts remain the recipient's property. Exact popped-job validation is not permission to trust a cached tool count. Recheck actual current body/source/access, declared window and permission; the four/five-minute shift admission deliberately leaves strictly more time than its duration. That is this local paid-shift policy, not a universal endpoint rule.

Controller registration differs from enrollment or installation. Earlier spawn/enroll paths must not auto-install the new controller before actual optional admission; body/location/clock inputs remain actor-specific and come from the same staged boundary. The root binding does not create a second clock, inventory or purse and does not copy the player's location to an independently working resident. Rendering supplies known reports/legal stock-backed actions, not a private purse or sheet. Optional absent state stays inert; the old expansion11 and admission revisions are historical integration targets, not a new schema assignment.

The parent's five connected records preserve different scope: actual artifact assembly, finite original causal proofs, a paid received-report route, 19 still-unactivated source-profile provenance records, and canonical routing recovery. None is a new whole-world adaptation or proof that a source-profile row became playable. Wider ACS research/DLC notes retain their original finite coverage and explicitly unread remainder; they did not expand this runtime wave. All five livelihood gate groups were unperformed at source release. Consult the actual later integrator before treating any root join as current verified runtime. No code, source library, private save, agent, build, gameplay or publication action is performed by this fold.
